description:
Ordena hasta 2.000 documentos para una consulta con BM25 (sin embeddings), con palabras sin tildes. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: ordenar hasta 2.000 vectores por similitud coseno con un vector consulta y devolver los k mejores (vector-top-k). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Ranks up to 2,000 documents for a query with Okapi BM25 (k1, b tunable) using accent-insensitive Unicode word tokens, e.g. to pick passages for retrieval without embeddings. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Ranks up to 2,000 documents for a query with Okapi BM25 (k1, b tunable) using accent-insensitive Unicode word tokens, e.g. to pick passages for retrieval without embeddings. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: ranking up to 2,000 candidate vectors by cosine similarity (vector-top-k). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

documents.description: Documents (array of string; required; at least 1 items; up to 2000 items).

k.description: Top k (integer; optional; default 5; min 1; max 2000).

query.description: Query (string; required; at least 1 chars; up to 2000 chars).
